mapper.sql: id, user_id, conversation_id, action_type, action_name, request_params, summary, risk_level, status, expire_at, confirmed_at, executed_at, result_data, error_message, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_pending_action (user_id, conversation_id, action_type, action_name, request_params, summary, risk_level, status, expire_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{actionType}, #{actionName}, #{requestParams}, #{summary}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_pending_action WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at > NOW() ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
